neighbours.label: The word right after 'for' / 'pour' / 'por' that opens a fixed adverbial phrase (for the time being, for the most part, for good reason, pour une fois, por lo tanto); the - pole is ' for' itself
fire: The bridge is closed, so for the time being we take the ferry.
Hier soir, pour une fois, les enfants ont rangé leur chambre.
Customers are angry, and for good reason.
La tienda cerró temprano, por lo tanto no compramos nada.
The summer was dry, but for the most part the crops survived.
The plan, for the time being, is to wait and see.
Il pleuvait encore, mais pour une fois personne ne s'est plaint.
Sales are, for the most part, steady this year.
quiet: The bridge is closed, so this week we take the ferry.
Hier soir, sans rien dire, les enfants ont rangé leur chambre.
Customers are angry about the new prices.
La tienda cerró temprano, así que no compramos nada.
The summer was dry, but most of the crops survived.
The plan, as agreed, is to wait and see.
Il pleuvait encore, mais cette fois personne ne s'est plaint.
We bought new flowers for the teacher this year.

notes: Card auto-test held for ' lo' after 'por'. Probe: 'for the time being' 0.69, 'pour une fois' 0.62, 'for good reason' 0.60, 'por lo tanto' 0.49, 'for the most part' 0.42, 'for a long time' 0.18; but sentence-final 'closed for good' only 0.02, and argument 'for my sister' 0.04, 'good for your health' 0.02.
